models.name: LFM2.5-24B-A2B
models.why: Liquid AI's on-device agent model: 24B total with ~2B active per token, a 131K context, and 184 t/s on an M5 Max on the 14.5GB 4-bit build with only 15GB of unified memory used, so a 16GB laptop can run it.

engines.quant: 4-bit build (14.5GB), 4K-token prompt, Liquid AI's own test

models.name: Qwen3.8-27B (TeksEdge DFlash2 + lookup, RTX 3090)
models.full_name: Qwen3.8-27B (TeksEdge inference-stack tuning on a single RTX 3090)
models.why: Same card, same weights: TeksEdge took Qwen3.8-27B from an 82 t/s baseline to 381 t/s on a single RTX 3090 by stacking MTP, DFlash2 context lookup and prefix caching, with ordinary chat at about 133 t/s.

engines.quant: DFlash2 + context lookup, prefix caching, 25K-token document reproduction (not ordinary chat; chat measured ~133 t/s)
DFlash2 + context lookup, optimized lookup verification (document-reproduction workload)

models.name: Qwen3.8-27B Twin Turbo
models.full_name: Qwen3.8-27B Twin Turbo (community tune: reasoning efficiency + MTP)
models.why: A community tune of Qwen3.8-27B that cuts reasoning tokens 2-20x and adds an MTP build: 75 t/s at Q4_K_S on an RTX 5090, over 90 t/s with the MTP build.

models.name: Qwen3.8-27B (iPad Pro + eGPU R9700)
models.full_name: Qwen3.8-27B (iPad Pro driving a Thunderbolt Sapphire R9700 eGPU)
models.why: An iPad Pro over Thunderbolt to a Sapphire R9700 eGPU runs Qwen3.8-27B at Q4 with a 131K context: 31 t/s standard decoding, 109 with MTP and 159 with DFlash2 draft-tree decoding, plus ~1,636 t/s prefill on 4K input.

engines.hardware: iPad Pro + Thunderbolt-connected Sapphire R9700 eGPU

models.name: Qwen3.8-27B on a jailbroken PS5
models.full_name: Qwen3.8-27B (llama.cpp port to a jailbroken PlayStation 5)
models.why: cobanov's PS5LM port of llama.cpp runs Qwen3.8-27B on a jailbroken PS5's 12 GiB at a 2-bit quant (UD-IQ2_XXS): 9-21 t/s, with the Vulkan backend on Mihawk-99's RADV port and models loaded from USB straight into GPU memory.

engines.hardware: Jailbroken PlayStation 5, 12 GiB GPU memory (Vulkan via Mihawk-99 RADV port)

models.name: Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 on DGX Spark
models.full_name: Qwen3.8-27B (NVFP4 weights served by SGLang with DFlash2 drafting)
models.why: A single DGX Spark serving NVFP4 weights through SGLang with a DFlash2 4-bit drafter holds 74 t/s at 8K context and still generates 38 t/s with 260K tokens in context (median of four runs, thinking off).

engines.quant: NVFP4 weights, DFlash2 speculative decoding with a 4-bit drafter (16 tokens per pass), BF16 KV cache, thinking disabled
